name: Pinnacle Aviation
address: Palomar Airport, San Diego area, California
summary: San Diego area flight school that lists a standard rate and a discount rate for each aircraft.
differentiator: Publishes two prices for every aircraft, a standard rate and a discount rate $10 to $15 an hour lower, and the discount depends on keeping a card on file and a $100 minimum balance.
pricing: Cessna 172R at $215 an hour standard ($200 discount), primary instruction $85 an hour.
feesNamed: Discount rate requires a credit card on file and at least $100 on account at all times, or prepaying the flight plus a $100 deposit
bestFor: Students who will keep a card and a balance on file to get the lower rate.
skipIf: You want one price with no conditions.
watchOut: The Cessna 172SP row shows several figures ($215/215/225) for different aircraft without naming which is which.
The page does not say whether rates include fuel.
